name: pixel-flow-vibe
description: Vibe-code Pixel Flow Nodes from natural language: author a node graph and encode it into a shareable #cfg= URL the app auto-loads. Targets Pixel Flow Nodes v2 (the deployed dataflow graph — 3D, particles, tracking, scenes, modular synth rack) and legacy Nodes v1. For Studio looks, install pixel-flow-studio-vibe.
